name: Weather mast
summary: Records temperature, pressure and humidity to a file on the SD card.

safety.text: No moving parts. Mount it out of direct sun for accurate readings.

steps.title: Connect the sensor
steps.body: Wire the sensor to the I²C pins on the Pi and check it is seen on the bus.

steps.title: Start logging
steps.body: Run the logger from the shell. It writes one line a minute to the card.
